channel.title: Data Points
channel.description: Your accelerated guide to AI news

item.title: Hackers break into Claude Mythos: OpenAI launches a security-specialized competitor to Mythos
item.description: Maine votes to pause construction of data centers. Journalists at major U.S. newspapers push back on publisher’s demand to use AI. AI-generated talking-head videos that support President Trump flood social media. Humanoid robots outrun human world record in a half-marathon race.

item.title: Insurance companies carve out exceptions for AI risks: U.S. military re-engages with Anthropic
item.description: A San Francisco retail store run by an AI agent. OpenAI’s specialized life-sciences model. Anthropic’s designs on the market for graphic design. Wall Street’s AI-driven workforce adjustments.

item.title: OpenAI and Microsoft sever their exclusive relationship: DeepSeek V4 makes a smaller splash
item.description: Google’s and Amazon’s huge bets on Anthropic. Google employees’ resistance to secret government use of AI. The U.S. threat to punish Chinese companies that distill U.S. AI models. An agentic system that autonomously designed a working CPU.

item.title: China shuts down Manus acquisition: All the details from Microsoft’s new deal with OpenAI
item.description: Nvidia’s laptop-sized omnimodal model. Grok cuts prices, boosts context. OpenAI’s AGI principles. IBM’s latest suite of open Granite models.

item.title: US government to vet new models: ChatGPT gets a model refresh
item.description: Anthropic’s latest products for banking and finance. Drug manufacturers get AI gains they didn’t expect. US military augments Anthropic with new partners. Google DeepMind’s UK unionization vote.

item.title: How Anthropic aligns its models: OpenAI improves realtime audio capabilities
item.description: Hermes, aka the new OpenClaw. DCI, aka the new RAG. NLAs, or how to peek inside Claude. TokenSpeed, aka the new TensorRT.

item.title: Thinking Machines debuts a new type of model: Google’s AI mouse promises better human-AI interaction
item.description: GitHub’s new Copilot pricing. Baidu’s smaller, faster flagship model. Google’s rethinking of mathematical research. RL Conductor’s orchestration of AI agents.

item.title: Anthropic passes OpenAI in business adoption: Cerebras stock debut makes more AI billionaires
item.description: Europe’s new media licensing initiative. ArXiv’s defenses against AI-assisted mistakes. The Mythos effect on financial institutions. Ukraine’s evolving drone and data strategy.

item.title: Cursor Composer undercuts competition: All the top news from Google’s I/O event
item.description: Google’s remade Antigravity, an alternative to IDEs. Omni Flash, Gemini’s voice-to-video generator. Google’s AI overhaul of web search. Corti’s Symphony, a specialist in medical transcription.

item.title: Qwen3.7-Max, China’s latest top model: OpenAI model disproves key math conjecture
item.description: Nvidia’s Gated DeltaNet-2, its latest attention alternative. Trump calls off executive order regulating U.S. AI models. Microsoft’s benchmark-topping suite of computer use agents. Cohere’s Command-A+, a local alternative to big cloud AI.

item.title: DeepSWE claims to measure agents better: Pope Leo XIV calls for AI to “disarm,” consider humanity
item.description: DeepSeek’s permanent V4 price cuts. MAI-Image-2.5, currently third on the Arena Leaderboard. Mythos-1’s remarkable security skills. How MCP will change later this year

item.title: Claude Opus 4.8 advertises its uncertainty: Dynamic workflows manage Anthropic subagents
item.description: MiniMax M3, the new open-weights champ. Nvidia’s PC superchips. Cosmos 3, an all-modal world/action model. Nvidia’s latest robotics partnerships.

item.title: Microsoft fully trains its own models: Copilot app brings agent management to desktop
item.description: How agents think about search. Hermes now a multi-platform desktop app. Qwen3.7-Plus, Alibaba’s midsized cloud model. OpenAI’s latest plugins for Codex.

item.title: Apple builds local/cloud models with Google: Gemma 4 12B, a laptop-sized model with multimodal power
item.description: The first working vaccine built by AI. Kimi CLI, Moonshot’s software engineering agent. The White House’s plans for an OpenAI stake. OpenJarvis, an open-source agent that learns on-device.

item.title: Claude Fable 5, or Mythos for the masses: Apple rethinks mixture-of-experts to save local memory
item.description: Google’s voice translation model covers 70+ languages. OpenAI’s preliminary public-offering paperwork. NotebookLM, now powered by Gemini 3.5 agents. FrontierCode, a new code-quality benchmark from Cognition.
